Multi-Head Attention · Where We Are03

Self Attention Analogy

Another mental model for self-attention might be "using tinder", where everyone on the app is simultaneously looking for someone and being looked at

  • Q – Query: What each person is looking for in a person
    • "I'm looking for a 10/10 terrachad ASU frat leader"
  • K – Key: the first photo each person has on their profile
    • "I'm a rocket"
  • V – Value: The rest of the profile
Multi-Head Attention · Self-Attention04

Self Attention Analogy

  • Q – Query: What each person is looking for in a person
    • "I'm looking for a 10/10 terrachad ASU frat leader"
  • K – Key: the first photo each person has on their profile
    • "I'm a baddie"
  • V – Value: The rest of the profile

As you swipe through profiles, you glance at the key of everyone (their first photo) and calculate how much they match your query (ASU frat leader) while everyone else is also doing the same.

Based on this, you calculate how much attention you should pay to all the values (actual profiles) of people you see.

Multi-Head Attention · Multi-Head Attention11

Multi-Head Attention

"Alice gave Bob a book."

A token's representation may need information about the giver, the recipient, and the object. Those are different retrieval questions. Multiple heads let the model learn different queries, matching criteria, and information to retrieve for each question.

  1. More heads: ask several questions of the current representations at once.
  2. More layers: use the results of earlier questions to ask new questions.

Multi-Head Attention · Programming Day18

Logical Partitioning of Weights

With logical partitioning we use only a single weight matrix and operation for creating Q, K, and V for every head. Each head then reads only from its assigned section of the larger Q, K, and V produced.

Multi-Head Attention · Programming Day19

LLM Inference with a KV Cache

We can make LLM inference more efficient by using a KV Cache

KV Cache: a "dictionary" that stores all of our previously computed Ks and Vs so we can re-use them (instead of needing to recalculate them) with future tokens

In multi-head attention, each head has its own KV Cache

Multi-Head Attention · KV Cache20

LLM Inference: Prefill and Decode

LLM inference can be broken down into two separate steps: Prefill and Decode

Prefill: reading phase where the model processes your entire input prompt all at once in parallel (this fills the KV cache).

Every time you send a new message to the LLM it performs a prefill step

LLM Inference: Prefill and Decode

LLM inference can be broken down into two separate steps: Prefill and Decode

Decode: writing phase where the model generates the output response one token at a time, sequentially, making use of the KV cache that was prefilled
